Decision framework - rules-based logic Choose with confidence Use the frameworks below to make the right choice for your vehicle. Choose MAIN DEALER if: ✅ Vehicle under manufacturer warranty ✅ Insurance job paying full cost ✅ Manufacturer goodwill contribution possible ✅ You want OEM parts only ✅ Vehicle is less than 3 years old ✅ You value dealer loan car ✅ You want OEM warranty (12-36 months) Default: Main dealer if under warranty, insurance-funded, or manufacturer goodwill available. Choose INDEPENDENT SPECIALIST if: ✅ Out of warranty ✅ Want recon/remanufactured (saving £500-£4,000+) ✅ Paying out of pocket ✅ Complex engine work (specialists do it daily) ✅ Vehicle is 5+ years old ✅ You want fixed-fee pricing ✅ Faster turnaround needed Default: Independent specialist if out of warranty and paying out of pocket.
